Definition: dust (as powdered or gray); hence, clay, earth, mud
BiblicalUsage: 1) dry earth, dust, powder, ashes, earth, ground, mortar, rubbish; 1a) dry or loose earth; 1b) debris; 1c) mortar; 1d) ore
